title: console: a dashboard (or list view) the server now refuses by `requiredPermissions` answers its direct URL with 403 PERMISSION_DENIED — surface the refusal to the user (the objectui half of objectstack#22611's ruling A)
body:
Filing gate: **④ a coordination node**, the objectui half of a ruling of record. Filed by the `domain:cli` seat 1 of objectstack (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6024) · `session_019SvPnd2bzECRNmAU9i6E4k`, now that the server half has landed. ⛔ Not a claim. objectui's triage grades it and names the lane.

## The ruling, and what landed

The director's ruling `6095014058` on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22611 (letter A, the maintainer's 「同意」), verbatim, the execution line: "the objectui half (the dashboard direct-URL refusal surfaced to the user; the switcher needs nothing)". objectstack-ai/objectstack#22639's body says the same: "The objectui half (the dashboard direct-URL refusal shown to the user) is filed when this half is accepted."

The server half landed as objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #22731 (`5081090b71`). The `/meta` read gate now applies a list view's and a dashboard's `requiredPermissions` (all of them required, no any-of form):
- `GET /api/v1/meta/view` and `/meta/dashboard` list only what the caller may open. A view container is listed minus the `list` / `listViews` entries the caller does not hold.
- A by-name read of a view or a dashboard the caller does not hold answers `403`, with nested `error.code` `PERMISSION_DENIED`, the app arm's whole refusal, and the message `You do not have permission to open the 'NAME' dashboard.` (or `view`).
- An object's own `listViews` inside `/meta/object` are pruned the same way, except for the class the object read serves whole (ADR-0106 D4: `isSystem`, or a holder of `manage_metadata`, `studio.access` or `setup.access`).

## What this card asks of the console

1. **The dashboard's direct URL.** A user who opens a dashboard they do not hold gets the server's `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. The console says so, in the server's words or as a permission refusal, ⛔ not a blank board, a spinner or a generic load failure. The same goes for a list view opened by name.
2. **To measure first (from the contract review of PR #22731, not measured in objectui):** the console's served-views reader (`useServedViewItems`) merges an object's `/meta/object` `listViews`. For a caller in the D4 class who does not hold a view's capability (for example a `studio.access` holder), the object read serves the view entry while its by-name read refuses it. The switcher could then list an entry that refuses on open. If it does, the card covers that path too (refused on open, said as such); if not, say so with the reading. The ruling's "the switcher needs nothing" holds for every other caller, because the switcher reads `GET /meta/view`, which is gated.

## Reach

The server answers above are on objectstack `main` from `5081090b71`. The console reads them once its pin carries that server, or against any runtime built from it. Nothing here waits on an objectstack release for the first item: it is a reader of an answer the server already gives.

## Duplicate check

REST `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues?state=all&since=2026-10-01` (3 pages), 113 issues from #11812 to #12111, closed included. Local grep: `requiredPermissions` within 200 characters of `dashboard` / `list view` / `listView`: 0 hits. `#22639` / `#22611`: 0. `audience-permission`: 0. `useServedViewItems`: 0. Control `dashboard`: 6 hits, all other subjects.
